goal: 1.5x–3x same-request committed Decode for d2/d3; exact state/logits/output; joint Prefill/TTFT/Decode/total reporting

budget.scope: Remove per-row cooperative boundary in composed verifier. A bounded architecture prerequisite; this family alone cannot close 40K. No forecast from launch count.

composition: Replace two per-layer scalar cooperative-grid residual/norm row loops with the existing exact independent-row Prefill kernel, one CTA per row. No new CUDA arithmetic, model representation, state publication, scratch allocation or geometry tuning.
numerical_ledger: Residual operands remain left + right and publish BF16 before normalization.
Each of the same 256 reduction lanes consumes indices lane + 256*j for j=0..19 in the same ordered fmaf chain.
The same shared binary tree reduces offsets 128/64/32/16/8/4/2/1.
Identical rsqrt(sum/5120+epsilon), centered gamma (weight+1), multiply order and BF16 output.
The first boundary has normalized_output == right, explicitly supported; residual output is disjoint. The second has disjoint inputs/outputs. No row communicates with another.
reference_transfer: Reuse already admitted native prompt-wide independent-row ownership; this is the same batching principle studied in vLLM/FLA but imports no source, numerical tree or state algorithm.
gates: build and full P65 scalar-prefix state/logit/cache/rejection/cancellation/failure admission
immediate P65/8K/40K d2 API, >3% slowdown stops; neutral removes; useful d2 unlocks d3
expiry: Immediate API decides removal or bounded dependency through next complete verifier API return or archival. No production promotion.
